clips.title: The story
paras: Book Return is an Elwynn Forest quest directing adventurers to recover Brother Paxton's lost reading materials from the infested depths of Fargodeep Mine. Chief among the missing volumes is 'Fun with Elementals,' a beginner's guide that risks granting the mine's kobolds dangerous conjuration abilities if left in their clutches.

While investigating the growing kobold menace within Fargodeep Mine, Marshal Dughan tasks adventurers with recovering missing volumes belonging to Brother Paxton of Northshire Abbey. Among the scattered texts lost in the dim subterranean tunnels is a particularly volatile primer titled 'Fun with Elementals.' Paxton fears that the instructions within are so accessible that even the mine's crude kobold squatters could decipher them and conjure an elemental creature in the depths.

Fargodeep Mine was once a prosperous gold venture for the kingdom of Stormwind, but recent troubles have allowed vermin to overrun its lower levels. As Elwynn's defenders stretch thin, recovered texts must be stored safely in a protective book bag to survive the damp, treacherous caverns. Retrieving Paxton's lost library ensures that mundane records are preserved and hazardous arcane lessons stay out of primitive hands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.
Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found all the books yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I applaud your diligence, friend. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.
You can keep that book bag!
